question: A part of the journey is covered in 22.5 minutes at a speed of 68 km/h and the remaining part in 12 minutes at a speed of 72 km/h. The total distance of the journey is (to the nearest integer):
solution:
**Given:**

A part of the journey is covered in 22.5 minutes at a speed of 68 km/h and the remaining part in 12 minutes at a speed of 72 km/h.

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

First part of journey:

Time = 22.5 minutes = 22.5/60 hours

Speed = 68 km/h

⇒ Distance₁ = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance₁ = 68 × (22.5/60)

⇒ Distance₁ = 68 × 0.375

⇒ Distance₁ = 25.5 km

Second part of journey:

Time = 12 minutes = 12/60 hours

Speed = 72 km/h

⇒ Distance₂ = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance₂ = 72 × (12/60)

⇒ Distance₂ = 72 × 0.2

⇒ Distance₂ = 14.4 km

Total Distance:

⇒ Total Distance = Distance₁ + Distance₂

⇒ Total Distance = 25.5 + 14.4 = 39.9 km 

⇒ Total Distance = 40 km (Approx)

**∴ The correct answer is option (4) 40 km.**
